## RESEARCH VERDICT

Verdict: accumulate  
Risk: medium  
Confidence: 0.72  
Rationale: Q3 filing EPS/FCF match the Yahoo screen; dividend cover looks ample, but AliGroup debt, commodity cyclicality and unrelated AAI-ticker filings in the corpus temper a full strong-buy endorsement.  
RiskTags: cyclical, leverage, regulatory, pension

## COMPARISON EVIDENCE

### EVIDENCE

- [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt] "• Generated $643 million in cash from operations; free cash flow was $472 million" — Q3 2026 operating and free cash flow align with `screening_snapshot.json` Yahoo quarter ended 2026-09-30 (not a separate filing annual aggregate).
- [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt] "• Net income attributable to Alcoa Corporation increased to $483 million, or $1.81 per share" — Confirms screen diluted EPS 1.81 for the same quarter.
- [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt] "Diluted $ 1.81 $ 0.88 $ 4.95 $ 3.57" — Nine months ended 30 Sep 2026 earnings growth versus prior year supports GARP/quality screen passes (Yahoo basis for trailing growth).
- [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt] "CASH PROVIDED FROM OPERATIONS 1,072 648" — Nine-month operating cash (2026 vs 2025) versus screen `operating_cashflow` 1,185M and `free_cashflow` 567M (Yahoo/screen periods differ from 9M filing subtotals).
- [filings/bodies/f0141768272fa670.txt] "Distribution Amount USD 0.10000000" — Ordinary quarterly dividend for period ending 30/9/2026; no cut flagged (update 4d8db67a697eb654 is FX only).
- [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt] "Finished the third quarter 2026 with a cash balance of $4.4 billion, including $2.6 billion of financing obtained for the acquisition" — Links strong liquidity to AliGroup funding and leverage risk.
- [filings/bodies/2757a3d323e825f6.txt] "to sell its aluminium value chain assets to Alcoa Corporation (Alcoa) (NYSE: AA; ASX: AAI ) for a n implied enterprise value of up to US$5.6B" — Scale and execution risk for the pending AliGroup transaction cited in Alcoa releases.
- [filings/bodies/c7724f741f4111e0.txt] "Amazing AI PLC (AAI)" — Filing index mixes unrelated UK listings with Alcoa ASX CDI material; lowers filing-corpus confidence (not Alcoa operational risk).

### NUMBERS

- Q3 diluted EPS | $1.81 | quarter ended 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt]
- Q3 free cash flow | $472 million | quarter ended 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt]
- Nine-month cash from operations | $1,072 million | nine months ended 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/ead52807c049bfbe.txt]
- Net debt | $414 million | as at 30 Sep 2026 | [filings/bodies/45617e6299b6acec.txt]
- Quarterly distribution | USD 0.10000000 | period ending 30/9/2026 | [filings/bodies/f0141768272fa670.txt]
- Screen FCF (headline) | 567000000.0 | `screening_snapshot.json` (Yahoo-derived; TTM FCF in same file 890000000.0) | [screening_snapshot.json]

### THESIS BREAKS

- Regulatory or shareholder failure blocking AliGroup close on disclosed terms, or debt drawn without expected synergies.
- Two consecutive quarters of negative filing free cash flow while the quarterly dividend is maintained without balance-sheet support.
- Sustained LME aluminium/alumina weakness driving adjusted EBITDA materially below Q3 2026 run-rate ($789M) in subsequent filed quarters.
- Material increase in adjusted net debt above Sep-2026 levels ($969M) without commensurate earnings from closed acquisitions.
